name: Weende proximate analysis
definition: The classical feed-analysis partition - dry matter, ash, crude protein, crude fat, crude fibre and the nitrogen-free remainder. Every fraction is defined by its method, not by a molecule

name: Fibre fractions
definition: Cell-wall fractions. The Van Soest detergent sequence (NDF, ADF, ADL) plus individually determined polymers and AOAC dietary fibre. NOT interchangeable with Weende crude fibre

name: Carbohydrates
definition: Starch and the free mono- and disaccharides

name: Calorific value
definition: Gross and net calorific value. Feed sources call gross energy GE, fuel sources call it HHV - one quantity

name: Fuel proximate analysis
definition: Volatile matter and fixed carbon, the combustion-science counterpart of the Weende partition. Reported by fuel databases such as Phyllis2, never by feed tables

name: Elemental analysis
definition: The CHNOS plus chlorine set of the ultimate analysis, and the C/N ratio derived from it. Sulphur and chlorine sit here rather than with the minerals because that is the tradition our sources report them in

name: Mineral elements
definition: Macro- and trace mineral elements as feed and agronomy report them, including the oxide forms P2O5 and K2O

name: Heavy metals and metalloids
definition: Contaminants that decide which applications a stream is admissible for

name: Other chemical properties
definition: Chemical properties belonging to no analytical partition above

name: Physical properties
definition: Bulk, particle and water-relation properties. Feeds the transport and handling side of the model
